angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,004,701 km at 92.93 pc = 0.14 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 10.7609 +/- 0.0203 mas (same row, RUWE 0.95): 92.93 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.444 (1.415 to 1.473) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 1,004,701 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.185 (1.145 to 1.225) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6117 +/- 0.8 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 6592695123423391616: teff_gspphot 6116.9478 K (16th-84th percentiles 6116.1553-6117.8145), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 6592695123423391616: teff_gspphot 6116.9478 K (16th-84th percentiles 6116.1553-6117.8145), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/samaya.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.193, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 205739 (pscomppars): spectral type F7 V, from Michigan Catalog, Vol. 3 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1982MSS...C03....0H/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 205739 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.19 dex, from Lopez-Morales et al. 2008 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2008AJ....136.1901L/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 205739 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.36, from Lopez-Morales et al. 2008 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2008AJ....136.1901L/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 205739 (pscomppars): age 2.84 Gyr, from Lopez-Morales et al. 2008 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2008AJ....136.1901L/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 205739 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 4.48 km/s, from Lopez-Morales et al. 2008 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2008AJ....136.1901L/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
